transcript.text: The back burner on our gas hob has gone a lazy yellow colour and leaves black soot on the pan. What's wrong with it?

A lazy yellow flame with soot usually means the gas isn't mixing properly with air at that specific burner. The most common cause is a simple issue: the burner cap or crown (the removable metal pieces on top) might be dirty, wet from recent cleaning, or not sitting perfectly flat. This disrupts the airflow and causes incomplete combustion. Please switch off the gas supply to the hob and let it cool completely. Then, lift off the burner cap and crown for that back burner. Check if they are dry, clean of any grease or food debris, and ensure they sit square and flat when replaced. If you've just cleaned them, make sure they are fully dry before reassembling.

Thank you. I've lifted the cap off and it looks all right to me, though there are some burnt spills around it. Should I clean those? I should also mention that I have noticed a faint smell of gas near the hob a few times in the mornings, even when all the knobs are off.

⚠ Stop using this appliance
If you can smell gas, treat it as an emergency: don't turn any switches on or off and no naked flames. Turn the gas off at the meter if you safely can, open doors and windows, and leave if the smell is strong. Call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999.

reading.symptom: back burner flame is lazy yellow and leaves black soot on the pan

plan: They asked: "What's wrong with it?" - answer that first.
The fault they reported is: "back burner flame is lazy yellow and leaves black soot on the pan". Keep to it: never describe a symptom, result or state they have not told you.

Stage 1 (broad help): say what could cause this, most likely first, as possibilities rather than certainties, including simple causes (settings, loading, detergent, installation, or normal behaviour) where they fit. Then give the one or two safe checks, or the one question, that would best tell those causes apart. Do not ask for the model number in this reply.

hazards.clause: i should also mention that i have noticed a faint smell of gas near the hob a few times in the mornings, even when all the knobs are off
